title: Install tracker
text: Install tracker with `pipx install tracker-cli`. Version 2.4 needs Python 3.10 or later. Run `tracker --version` to check the install.

title: Create a task list
text: Run `tracker init --dir ~/tasks` to create a task list. The `--dir` option sets where the list lives; without it, tracker uses ~/.tracker. The command fails if the folder already contains a task list.

title: Where tracker stores data
text: Each task list is one SQLite file named tasks.db inside the list folder, ~/.tracker by default. Back up that file to back up every task, tag and comment. Close running tracker commands before you copy it.

title: Sync with a remote
text: `tracker sync` pushes local changes and pulls remote ones. Sync takes a lock on the remote, so a second machine that syncs at the same time waits up to 30 seconds and then exits with 'remote is locked'. Running sync from two machines at once is safe.

title: Archive and delete
text: `tracker archive ID` hides a task from `tracker list` but keeps it in tasks.db; `tracker restore ID` brings it back. `tracker delete ID` removes the task permanently and cannot be undone.

title: Import from CSV
text: `tracker import FILE.csv` reads columns title, due and tags. Rows without a title are skipped and counted in the summary line. Use `--dry-run` to see the summary without writing tasks.

title: Configuration keys
text: tracker reads config.toml from the list folder. Allowed keys are default_project, week_start (monday or sunday), color (auto, always or never) and editor.

title: Output formats
text: `tracker list` prints a table. Color follows the color setting; with color = auto, tracker turns color off when standard output is not a terminal. `tracker list --format csv` prints comma-separated rows.

title: API tokens
text: `tracker login` stores an API token in the system keychain. `tracker logout` removes it. Tokens expire after 90 days; run `tracker login` again to get a new one.

title: Debug logging
text: `--debug` writes request details to debug.log in the list folder. Version 2.4.1 redacts API tokens in debug output; earlier versions do not.
